messages:
mira (Marketing): Quick check  need statuspage copy + an embargoed customer email and a one-line social blurb. Hold public post until Monitoring. Can someone propose two micro-variants? @alex @jo

alex (SRE): Timeline: degraded RPCs 16:08 UTC, rollback @16:27, healthy @16:35. Suspected autoscale config triggered excessive batching. Monitoring in progress; root cause follow-up pending.

jo (Support): I'll assemble impacted-account CSV and prepare canned replies. ETA 20m. Need email subject and small FAQ for support replies.

nia (Legal): Don't suggest data impact. Use: "no indication of customer data exposure at this time" only after log check confirmation.

mira (Marketing): Variant 1 (clear):
`Partial service degradation affecting a subset of API requests between 16:08 and 16:35 UTC. We reverted a configuration change; systems are healthy and under monitoring. We will publish a detailed incident report within 72 hours.`

Variant 2 (concise):
`Service degradation for a subset of requests 16:0816:35 UTC. Rollback applied; systems healthy. Monitoring continues. Follow-up to come.`

felix (Growth): For lead routing: tag trial signups and demo requests during the window with "inc-5123" and route to on-call AEs. Add a note to CRM for follow-up.

mira (Marketing): Plan: 1) Post StatusPage using Variant 1 now as Identified->Monitoring. 2) Hold targeted email until jo uploads CSV and Alex confirms data-language. 3) Tweet only after Monitoring. 4) Postmortem + report within 72 hours. Any objections?

alex (SRE): +1. Will confirm logs in ~10m. No signs so far.

nia (Legal): +1 pending Alex confirmation.

jo (Support): CSV will be uploaded to /shared/incidents/inc-5123.csv in ~18m. Preparing reply templates.

statusbot: Incident INC-5123 updated by alex: state=identified, severity=low. (link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-5123)

mira (Marketing): Thanks everyone  posting now and will queue the email once CSV and legal greenlight arrive.
